README: SEED / APPROXIMATE zone reference points - 2023 USDA Plant Hardiness Zone Map, one point per frost-station city, pending the full PRISM raster/ZIP table.

zone: taken verbatim from the official PRISM/USDA-ARS 2023 ZIP-code dataset phzm_us_zipcode_2023.csv (schema zipcode,zone,trange,zonetitle; canonical source https://prism.oregonstate.edu/projects/phm_data/phzm_us_zipcode_2023.csv). Direct prism.oregonstate.edu and phzmapi.org egress was blocked in the build environment, so the file was fetched from two independent GitHub mirrors which were byte-identical (md5 5722dd8d764648ce3dacca4828508703): raw.githubusercontent.com/tamu-capstone-gardener/rails-react@32893b3d/app/assets/csv/phzm_us_zipcode_2023.csv and raw.githubusercontent.com/BalancedProtector/GardenBoxPrototype@082d7d76/data/phzm_us_zipcode_2023.csv.

lat/lng: the US Census Bureau 2020 ZCTA5 Gazetteer internal point for the same ZIP (columns GEOID, INTPTLAT, INTPTLONG; canonical source https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2020_Gazetteer/2020_Gaz_zcta_national.zip, fetched from the bundled verbatim copy at raw.githubusercontent.com/Anervea-AI/ct-access@a2ab11c9/backend/app/data/geo_ref/2020_Gaz_zcta_national.txt).

Each point records which ZIP it represents (zip) and the city (place). Lookup is nearest-point by great-circle distance and is only as good as this sparse seed - a site far from every point gets the zone of the closest city, which may be wrong. Replace with the full PRISM table before relying on it beyond these cities.

ZIP 60666 (Chicago O'Hare) was attempted but is absent from both the PRISM ZIP dataset and the Census gazetteer (non-residential ZIP); 60601 (Chicago Loop) is used instead - exclusion, not substitution of invented data.
